title: Empirical probability density
statement: Let $n,m$ be nonnegative integers with $m>0$, and let $x_0,\ldots,x_{m-1}$ be vectors in the binary cube of dimension $n$. The associated probability density on that cube is the density of the uniform distribution on the sample indices pushed forward by the map sending each index to its sample vector.
hypotheses_covered: The samples are indexed by $\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ and lie in the binary cube of dimension $n$
